Name: Nug's Fairy Drakelings
Author: nugmods
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53527/53527-1791411833-1291740549.gif[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53527/53527-1791387778-205893298.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#29292e][size=1]Overview[/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[left]Deep in the forests and mountains surrounding Pelican Town, magical [b]Fairy Drakelings[/b] have laid their eggs for you to find. Their environment influences the form they take, and as the seasons change, so do the kind of Drakeling eggs you can find.

This mod adds [b]6 types of Fairy Drakelings[/b] to raise in your coop; [b]4[/b] for the seasons of Ferngill, and [b]2 more[/b] secret varieties for you to hunt down during your adventures. In addition, this mod adds [b]2 new crops[/b], [b]1 new mushroom[/b], [b]1 gem,[/b] [b]1 mineral[/b], and [b]6 new cooking recipes[/b] that you'll learn as your foraging level increases.[/left]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53527/53527-1791335615-1031196613.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#29292e][size=1]Features[/size][/color][/center]
[left]Unlike your cows and chickens, Fairy Drakelings can't be purchased from Marnie. Instead, inspired by Axell's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43539]Hootin' and Hollerin'[/url], you'll have to forage their eggs out in the wild and hatch them in an incubator. Every season, you'll find a different type of Common Drakeling egg; still other Rare Drakeling eggs must be found in the far-flung corners of Ferngill.

[b]Drakeling Variants and Egg Locations:[/b]
[spoiler][b]Spring Drakeling:[/b] eggs can be found in the Backwoods, Mountains, and Cindersap Forest in Spring.
[b]Summer Drakeling:[/b] eggs can be found in the Backwoods, Mountains, and Cindersap Forest in Summer. 
[b]Autumn Drakeling[/b]: eggs can be found in the Backwoods, Mountains, and Cindersap Forest in Autumn. 
[b]Winter Drakeling:[/b] eggs can be found in the Backwoods, Mountains, and Cindersap Forest in Winter. 
[b]Void Drakeling:[/b] eggs can be purchased from Krobus for 10,000 gold.
[b]Iridium Drakeling:[/b] eggs can be purchased from the Island Trader for 5 dragon teeth.

Seasonal eggs will also spawn in areas added by Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Sunberry Village, and Visit Mt. Vapius if you have these installed.

Drakeling eggs are relatively rare, and not guaranteed to spawn every day. It may take several days of searching to find one, so be patient; the hunt is part of the experience![/spoiler]
Like your chickens, ducks, and dinosaurs, each Drakeling lays eggs, and these eggs can be processed in the Mayonnaise Maker. However, [i]unlike [/i]your chickens, ducks, and dinosaurs, Drakeling eggs will not produce mayonnaise; they're made of delicate magical energies, not whites and yolks, and they turn to [b]Colorful Fairy Dust[/b] under duress. Not to fret: certain collectors will still pay a pretty penny for this fairy dust! And who knows, maybe you can find ways to put it to good use...

At high friendship, Drakelings will be delighted to bring you pretty trinkets and magical forage they find in their environment. These can be sold or processed according to their type, but you may also find further uses for them as your foraging level grows.

[b]Deluxe Produce:[/b]
[spoiler][b]Vernal Blossom:[/b] can be placed in the seed maker to produce seeds. Can be dried with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia[/url] or candied with [url=https://visitmountvapius.wiki.gg/]Visit Mt. Vapius[/url].
[b]Estival Berry:[/b] Can be placed in the seed maker to produce seeds. Can be put in the keg to produce juice or dried in the dehydrator.
[b]Autumnal Mushroom:[/b] Can be dried or pickled.
[b]Hibernal Crystal:[/b] Can be placed in the crystalarium or processed into trinkets with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46186]Appleseed's Lathe.[/url]
[b]Umbral Horn:[/b] Can be processed into decorative horns with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46186]Appleseed's Lathe.[/url]
[b]Sidereal Geode:[/b] Can be processed into trinkets with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46186]Appleseed's Lathe.[/url] its energies are too powerful for your crystalarium.

This is not an exhaustive list of compatible mods. Any artisan machines mod that uses the appropriate context tags for flowers, fruit, mushrooms, gems, minerals, or horns can process these items.[/spoiler]
As you level up your foraging skill, you'll learn recipes for powerful potions that give different kinds of buffs, depending on the ingredients used. Lucky for you, your Drakelings have brought you just the ingredients you need to brew these potions!
[b]
Potions & Buffs:[/b]
[spoiler][b]
Vernal Potion (Pink Fairy Dust + Vernal Blossom) grants [i]Aspect of Spring:[/i][/b] +Defense, +Foraging, +Luck
[b]Estival Potion (Green Fairy Dust + Estival Berry) grants [i]Aspect of Summer:[/i][/b] +Speed, +Fishing, +Luck
[b]Autumnal Potion (Red Fairy Dust + Autumnal Mushroom) grants [i]Aspect of Autumn:[/i][/b] +Attack, +Combat, +Luck
[b]Hibernal Potion (Blue Fairy Dust + Hibernal Crystal)  grants [i]Aspect of Winter:[/i][/b] +Immunity, +Mining, +Luck
[b]Umbral Potion (Dark Fairy Dust + Umbral Horn) grants [i]Aspect of the Void:[/i][/b] +Immunity, +Defense, +Attack, +Speed, -Energy, -Luck
[b]Sidereal Potion (Iridium Fairy Dust + Sidereal Geode) grants [i]Aspect of the Stars:[/i][/b] +Immunity, +Defense, +Attack, +Speed, +Luck, +Combat, +Mining, +Foraging, +Fishing

Vernal, Estival, Autumnal, Hibernal, and Umbral Potion recipes are learned at Foraging 5. Sidereal Potion recipe is learned at Foraging 10.[/spoiler]
For extra fun, I recommend using mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46186]Appleseed's Lathe[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7784]Lumisteria More Pickled Products[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mt. Vapius[/url] alongside Fairy Drakelings.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53527/53527-1791335680-1759792232.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#29292e][size=1]Installation[/size][/color][/center]
1. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url] in your mod folder, or egg spawns won't work.
2. Download and install Fairy Drakleings in your mod folder.
3. That's all, folks! You will now find eggs in your world and be able to raise little fairy lads.
